gain = gain_db_at(V(out), 10) >= 50
gbw = unity_gain_freq(V(out)) >= 20Meg

input.reason: More first-stage current for bandwidth at ss and 125 C; a stronger second stage and a faster mirror for phase margin at ff and -40 C

answer: At the start the op-amp missed 20 MHz at ss/125C (15.2 MHz) and 60 degrees at ff/-40C (57 degrees). Raising IB to 18 uA gives the first stage more gm, so the unity-gain frequency at ss and 125 C reaches about 21 MHz. That also moves the bandwidth up at ff and -40 C, so the second stage needs more transconductance: M6 now has 8 fingers and M7 sinks 4/3 of its old current per IB, which pushes the output pole and the right-half-plane zero out, and shorter mirror devices M3 and M4 (2/0.5 um) move the mirror pole up. check_specs at all 15 corners: gain at least 52.8 dB (fs/125C), unity-gain frequency at least 21.3 MHz (ss/125C), phase margin at least 66 degrees (ff/-40C).
